description:
Ukrainian bankruptcy and insolvency announcements (ДСА registry).

One result is one published announcement, not one case. A case accumulates
announcements as it proceeds and long-running cases have hundreds, so use
`get_case` for one case's history and current stage.

Company names are stored in full legal form and in capitals, so a distinctive
fragment of the trade name works far better than an exact name. `debtor_code` is
the reliable way to identify a party.

query.description: Debtor name, matched anywhere in the string.

name: ua_bankruptcy__search
title: Search Bankruptcy Announcements
